name: Made for Julia
description: The cute moving background for Julia's pink texture pack: soft pink clouds with little hearts and flowers floating up, on every menu, the loading screen and Geode's mods screen.

enabled.name: Moving background
enabled.description: Soft pink clouds with little hearts and flowers floating up, behind every menu.

main-menu.name: On the main menu too
main-menu.description: Uses it on the main menu instead of the running icons.

loading-screen.name: On the loading screen
loading-screen.description: Uses it on the game's loading screen instead of the blue squares (next time the game starts).

geode-menu.name: Pink Geode mods screen
geode-menu.description: Gives Geode's mods screen her pinks and the moving background.

round-fill.name: Rounded slider fill
round-fill.description: The volume sliders and loading bar fill up as a smooth pink pill instead of a square-ended strip.

clean-saved.name: Clean saved levels
clean-saved.description: Saved and favorite levels only keep the back button, the heart and the page arrows.

accent.name: Accent colour
accent.description: Match the pack version: Purple for "Made for Julia", Black for "Made for Julia (black)".
